title: Kettlebell 8 Week Program
author: Steve-o
desc:
An 8-week home strength program built around a single 12kg kettlebell and your own bodyweight. Four sessions a week, roughly 45 minutes each.

The problem it solves: one light bell can't be made heavier, so the usual "add 2.5kg" progression is off the table. This program progresses by changing the movement, the tempo, the leverage, the rest and the ballistic demand instead. Same bell in week 8, considerably harder work.

The ballistic side runs as a taught ladder: swings for the first two weeks, high pulls introduced in week 3, snatches in week 5, and by week 7 you are doing snatches on the minute. Each new movement arrives as low-rep technique work while the previous one is still carrying the conditioning load. No Turkish get-ups anywhere, they take longer to learn than they give back here.
